image_prompts.idea_pt: Mascote vinil sentado na cama às 2:47 da manhã, roendo a pontinha da pata, olhando o celular com gráfico de candles e calendário de earnings; abajur quente, xícaras de espresso vazias, post-its 'EPS??' / 'guidance...' / 'after the bell', máscara de dormir sem uso na testa.
image_prompts.prompt:
Photorealistic magazine editorial photo, 35mm lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, taken at 2:47 AM in a real, lived-in bedroom. A warm tungsten bedside lamp is the key light (about 2700K), soft natural shadows, plus a faint, gentle spill from a phone screen. Rumpled white linen duvet, creased pillows, a wooden nightstand crowded with three empty espresso cups, a half-eaten bag of pretzels and a small analog alarm clock reading 2:47. Yellow sticky notes are stuck to the lampshade and headboard, with hand-scribbled words: "EPS??", "guidance...", "after the bell". A real smartphone lies face-up on the duvet showing a plain red-and-green candlestick chart and a generic earnings calendar, with no company logos or tickers.

Sitting up in the middle of the bed, half tucked under the duvet, is Fluxion's official mascot as a glossy black vinyl collectible toy about 22 cm tall: a cat-like figure with three spiky ears, a white swirl logo centered on the forehead, a blue-to-purple glowing visor with cyan LED eyes, a glowing nebula belly and a flame-tipped tail. Pose: wide awake and anxious. It hunches forward, nervously nibbling the tip of one paw like biting its nails, eyes wide and locked on the phone, tail curled tight around its body, one ear slightly drooped. An unused sleep mask is pushed up on its forehead. Realistic vinyl highlights from the lamp, a soft contact shadow and a small dent in the duvet under the toy. The only glow in the frame comes from the toy's visor, eyes, belly and tail, faint and contained on the toy.

Mood: relatable late-night earnings-season anxiety, funny, not scary. Muted real colors, cozy warm tones, light natural film grain, editorial lifestyle photography. Optional headline at the top in clean bold white sans-serif: "earnings season". 4:5 vertical.

Avoid: neon environments, glowing water, purple/cyan fantasy CGI backgrounds, oversaturated sci-fi, CGI or AI-looking backgrounds, real company logos or tickers, readable price numbers, horror vibes, and any on-image text besides the sticky notes and the optional headline.
